column2: The wide calm River Nile at dawn with thin mist on the water, tall papyrus reeds along the bank, an ancient Egyptian fisherman in a white linen kilt standing in a small papyrus reed boat holding a net, pale gold sky behind low hills

A narrow green strip of wheat fields and date palms along the Nile in ancient Egypt ending sharply at golden desert sand and rocky hills, a small mud-brick village, a farmer with a donkey on the path, warm evening light

Ancient Egyptian fields covered by the shallow brown floodwater of the Nile, villages of mud-brick houses standing on little mounds like islands, palm trees, people in white linen paddling small boats between them, soft golden light

The ancient city of Thebes seen from the Nile, low brown mud-brick houses with flat roofs and palm gardens along the eastern bank, huge painted stone temple gateways with long flags on tall poles rising above, sailing boats on the river, morning light

The steep golden desert cliffs on the west bank of the Nile at Thebes in ancient Egypt, green fields at their foot, a pale sandstone mortuary temple with long colonnaded terraces cut into the cliff, a pyramid-shaped peak above, late afternoon golden light

A small ancient Egyptian farming village of whitewashed mud-brick houses with flat roofs among date palms near the Nile, a family in simple white linen in the courtyard, goats and ducks, early morning light

An ancient Egyptian woman in a long white linen dress kneeling in a mud-brick courtyard grinding grain on a flat stone, a beehive-shaped clay oven with fire beside her, round loaves of bread, soft morning light

An ancient Egyptian farmer in a linen kilt guiding a simple wooden plough pulled by two oxen through dark wet Nile mud, his son behind him scattering seed from a basket, palm trees and the river beyond, soft morning light
An ancient Egyptian man using a shaduf, a long wooden pole with a bucket and counterweight, to lift water from a canal into a green garden of onions and lettuce, date palms, calm warm light

Ancient Egyptian farmers in linen kilts cutting golden wheat with sickles, women and children gathering the ears into baskets, a man playing a reed flute at the edge of the field, palm trees and the Nile, warm golden light

A narrow winding street in ancient Thebes with two-storey whitewashed mud-brick houses, open wooden doors to shady courtyards, people in white linen walking, a donkey carrying baskets, soft morning light
A busy ancient Egyptian harbour on the Nile with wooden cargo boats with tall square sails, workers unloading jars and grain sacks, small papyrus reed boats, temple walls behind, warm morning light

An ancient Egyptian workshop with craftsmen in linen kilts at low wooden tables, a potter at his wheel, a carpenter with a bronze saw, a jeweller setting blue and red stones into a gold collar, warm light through a doorway

The enormous painted stone gateway of the temple of Karnak in ancient Egypt, bright colours on the walls, long flags fluttering on tall cedar poles in front, pink granite obelisks topped with gold, small figures of people at the gate, golden light

Ancient Egyptian priests with shaved heads in white linen walking slowly through a dim temple hall of huge painted stone columns, carrying offerings of bread and flowers, beams of light from high windows, incense smoke

A small walled village of brown mud-brick houses with flat roofs and plain wooden doors along one narrow dirt street in a narrow rocky desert valley in ancient Egypt, golden hills all around, villagers in white linen, warm evening light

A group of ancient Egyptian tomb workers in linen kilts carrying tools and baskets walking along a narrow path over rocky desert hills at dawn, the green Nile valley and a distant city far below, soft pink sky

An ancient Egyptian scribe sitting cross-legged in the shade of a rock writing with a reed pen on a white limestone flake, a wooden palette with black and red ink beside him, desert valley behind, warm light

Ancient Egyptian painters working inside a rock-cut tomb by the light of small oil lamps, filling in colourful figures of gods on a smooth plastered wall with blue, green, red and yellow paint, warm lamplight and shadows

An ancient Egyptian village of mud-brick houses at dusk, families sitting on the flat roofs, smoke rising from cooking fires, children playing in the street, red and purple hills around, calm and peaceful

An ancient Egyptian scribe in fine white linen sitting cross-legged in a shady courtyard with a roll of papyrus across his knees, writing with a reed pen, a wooden palette with ink cakes beside him, soft warm light

Ancient Egyptian schoolboys in short linen kilts sitting on reed mats copying hieroglyphs onto white plastered wooden boards, an older scribe teacher watching, in a temple courtyard with columns, soft morning light
An ancient Egyptian mother and her daughter in long linen dresses weaving linen on a horizontal loom in a sunny mud-brick courtyard, spindles and baskets of flax thread, a cat nearby, warm light
Ancient Egyptian children in simple linen clothes playing with a leather ball and a wooden toy animal on wheels in a sunny courtyard, palm tree and mud-brick walls, a dog watching, joyful and calm
A slender ancient Egyptian cat sleeping on a cushion in a niche of a whitewashed mud-brick house, a senet game board and a small oil lamp nearby, soft evening light through a small high window

The ancient Egyptian city of Amarna newly built beside the Nile on an open desert plain, long straight streets of white mud-brick buildings, palaces with gardens, open-air temples, cliffs behind, bright morning light

An ancient Egyptian open-air temple courtyard at Amarna with hundreds of small stone altars piled with bread, fruit and flowers under the bright open sky, priests in white linen, sunlight pouring down

A beautiful ancient Egyptian palace garden at Amarna with a rectangular pool of blue water and lotus flowers, palm and sycamore trees, painted columns, a few ladies in pleated white linen walking, soft golden light

An ancient Egyptian king and queen in pleated white linen sitting together in a palace hall with their little daughters on their laps, playing with them tenderly, sunlight streaming in, warm and gentle, painted walls
An ancient Egyptian nurse in a white linen dress holding a small baby boy on her lap in a cool palace room with painted walls and a small footstool, soft light from a high window, gentle and calm
An ordinary ancient Egyptian family in a simple mud-brick house in the evening quietly praying before a small statue of an old god in a wall niche, a little oil lamp glowing, peaceful and private

A young boy king of ancient Egypt about nine years old in white linen and a golden collar wearing the blue crown, holding a small crook and flail, standing in a great temple hall among priests and officials, golden light

An elderly ancient Egyptian official with a calm wise face, wearing fine pleated linen and a gold collar, standing beside a throne in a painted palace hall, other officials in the background, soft warm light
An ancient Egyptian treasurer in fine linen with a gold collar examining papyrus accounts with scribes in a storeroom full of sealed jars, gold rings and grain sacks, light from a doorway

An abandoned ancient Egyptian city of white mud-brick palaces on the desert edge, sand drifting in through empty doorways and against walls, a few last families with donkeys leaving along the road, soft evening light
An ancient Egyptian palace among palm gardens beside the Nile at Memphis, thick brown mud-brick walls, and far away on the desert edge the great pyramids standing pale against a glowing evening sky

A slender young pharaoh about eighteen in white linen driving a light wooden chariot pulled by two horses across golden desert sand, holding a bow, a slim hunting dog running beside the wheels, ostriches far ahead, soft dust and warm light

A young ancient Egyptian queen in a long pleated white linen dress and a gold collar walking in a palace garden among lotus pools and sycamore trees, holding a lotus flower, soft golden light, calm and graceful

A young pharaoh relaxed on a cushioned golden chair, his young queen in a pleated dress gently touching his shoulder and holding a small cup of perfumed oil, in a palace room, sun rays falling from above, warm golden light

An ancient Egyptian palace hall with tall wooden columns painted like papyrus bundles, a painted floor showing a pool with fish, lotus flowers and birds, high windows with stone grilles, servants with ostrich feather fans

An ancient Egyptian evening banquet, women in white linen playing a harp, a lute and a double flute, guests seated on low chairs wearing flower garlands, oil lamps, warm golden light, calm and elegant

A young ancient Egyptian king and queen in a light papyrus boat among tall papyrus reeds and lotus flowers in a marsh, herons and ducks, the king holding a throwing stick, the queen holding a lotus, soft morning light

A young ancient Egyptian king and queen standing together on a palace roof terrace looking out over the Nile at sunset, the sun going down behind the western desert, white sails on the golden water, swallows in the sky

A festive crowd of ancient Egyptians in white linen lining a long avenue of stone sphinxes in Thebes during a great festival, flags, flowers, musicians, temple gateway in the distance, bright joyful light

Ancient Egyptian priests in white linen with shaved heads carrying a golden sacred boat with a veiled shrine on long poles on their shoulders, coming out of a huge temple gateway, incense smoke, crowds bowing

Ancient Egyptian temple singers and musicians in a procession, women shaking bronze sistrum rattles, drummers and clapper players, incense smoke drifting, people kneeling along the way, warm festive light
A great golden ceremonial barge on the Nile being towed upstream by lines of men pulling long ropes along the bank, crowds walking and cheering beside them, soldiers and dancers, bright morning light
The tall papyrus columns of the colonnade of Luxor temple in ancient Egypt at dusk, priests carrying a golden boat inside, torches flickering on the stone walls, warm firelight and deep blue sky

Ancient Egyptian families sitting on the bank of the Nile at night during a festival, small oil lamps glowing, boats with lamps bobbing on the dark water, a child asleep in a parent's lap, a starry sky
Green fields of young wheat and barley along the Nile in ancient Egypt on a mild winter morning, a farmer in a woollen cloak, palm trees, mist on the river, soft gentle light
Ancient Egyptian scribes sitting with papyrus rolls counting sacks of grain being carried into a large mud-brick granary with domed silos, workers in linen kilts, warm afternoon light
A slender young pharaoh in white linen walking slowly with a carved walking stick through a palace garden of palm trees and a lotus pool, a servant following, soft afternoon light, calm
A quiet ancient Egyptian palace room at night lit by small oil lamps, a bed with lion legs and white linen, a doctor-priest sitting nearby in prayer, painted walls in shadow, still and calm
Ancient Egyptian women of the royal household in plain white linen with loose hair sitting in a quiet palace courtyard in grief, a young queen among them, soft grey evening light, calm and sorrowful

The western cliffs above the Valley of the Kings at Thebes at dusk, red and gold rock fading into darkness, a few small brown mud-brick huts with a glow of oil-lamp light below, the Nile reflecting the last light

A light tent of reed and white linen on the west bank of the Nile at the edge of the desert, ancient Egyptian priests in white linen walking quietly toward it, clean water jars, cliffs behind, soft morning light

Inside an ancient Egyptian embalming workshop, neat rolls of fine white linen bandages, jars of oils and resins, baskets of white natron salt, small golden amulets on a table, soft light through linen walls, calm and sacred, no body
Ancient Egyptian goldsmiths in a royal workshop hammering and shaping sheets of gold, a golden coffin lid being polished, gold collars and boxes on tables, small furnace glowing, warm firelight
Ancient Egyptian workers in linen kilts carrying baskets of stone chips up a short staircase cut into the floor of a dry rocky desert valley, golden cliffs around, bright midday light
An ancient Egyptian royal storeroom with painted wooden chests, gilded chairs, beds with lion legs, jars and baskets, and a gilded chariot taken apart, servants packing things carefully, lamplight
A young ancient Egyptian queen in plain white linen weaving a small wreath of blue cornflowers, olive leaves and blue lotus petals by a palace window, soft spring light, gentle and quiet
Ancient Egyptian funeral boats decorated with flowers crossing the calm Nile at dawn toward golden western cliffs, a shrine on the largest boat, white egrets flying from the reeds, soft pale light
Ancient Egyptian mourning women in pale blue linen raising their arms on the riverbank as a funeral procession passes, priests with incense, dust drifting in the morning breeze, calm and solemn

Twelve ancient Egyptian officials in white linen with white bands on their foreheads pulling a wooden sledge with a golden shrine by ropes across the desert toward rocky hills, priests and mourners following, golden light

A small ancient Egyptian funeral procession winding slowly up a dry narrow rocky valley with steep golden walls and a pyramid-shaped peak above, servants carrying chests and furniture, bright clear sky

An elderly ancient Egyptian priest wearing a leopard skin over white linen performing a sacred ceremony before an upright golden coffin at the top of stone steps in a desert valley, priests with incense around him, soft light

Ancient Egyptian mourners wearing collars of flowers and leaves sharing a quiet funeral meal of bread, duck and wine on mats in a desert valley at evening, golden cliffs glowing behind, calm and solemn
A young ancient Egyptian queen in plain white linen standing alone at a palace window looking out over the Nile at evening, a lotus flower in her hand, soft golden light, quiet and thoughtful
A Bronze Age Hittite king with a long robe and a tall cap seated in a stone palace hall in the mountains of Anatolia, reading a clay tablet letter brought by a messenger, warm torchlight
A small Bronze Age travelling company with horses, donkeys and a chariot moving along a dusty road through dry hills of Syria at sunset, long shadows, calm and quiet
An ancient Egyptian stonemason with a copper chisel and mallet carving hieroglyphs on a temple wall, an overseer watching, painted reliefs of priests and boats on the wall, warm afternoon light
Ancient Egyptian officials by torchlight tidying wooden chests inside a crowded small tomb room and stamping a plastered doorway with a seal, golden objects in the shadows, warm torchlight
Small rough stone huts of ancient Egyptian workmen in a dry rocky desert valley among piles of white stone chips, a large tomb entrance in the cliff above, evening light, quiet and empty
